title: Deployable N-replica Paxos
description: The extracted replica state machine (acceptor, proposer with ballot allocation and nack-driven retry, learner) composed into a deployment of any N replicas (1 ≤ N ≤ 255, majority quorums) whose network may delay, duplicate, reorder or drop authenticated messages, and whose replicas may crash and restart from storage written before each send. Safety needs no timing assumption. Liveness assumes a stable leader in a live majority, fair delivery within that majority, and ballots below 2^62 − 2N. Excluded: sockets, codecs and storage code in src/bin, the Rust compiler and the extractor.

claims.name: no_panic
claims.description: The extracted transition function returns normally for every replica state and every input, including malformed sender ids, vectors of the wrong length, an empty cluster and exhausted ballots; its loops terminate.
claims.statement: ∀ (n : deployable_paxos.Node) (i : deployable_paxos.Input), ∃ r, deployable_paxos.Node.handle n i = Aeneas.Std.RustM.ok r

claims.name: refinement
claims.description: For every cluster size, every reachable deployment state interprets as a reachable state of the abstract majority-quorum Paxos model.
claims.statement: ∀ (N : Nat) [PaxosSystem.Cluster N] (w : PaxosSystem.World N), RMVerify.Reactive.Reachable (PaxosSystem.module N) w → RMVerify.Reactive.Reachable (PaxosN.module N) (PaxosSystem.abs w)
claims.proof: by intro N _ w h; exact PaxosSystem.refinement w h

claims.name: agreement
claims.description: For every cluster size, no two replicas ever decide different values, in every reachable state.

claims.name: validity
claims.description: For every cluster size, every decided value was submitted by a client.

claims.name: eventual_decision
claims.description: For every cluster size, in every execution satisfying the environment assumptions (Live), every replica of some majority eventually decides.
claims.statement: ∀ (N : Nat) [PaxosSystem.Cluster N], RMVerify.Spec.Eventually (PaxosSystem.module N) PaxosSystem.Live PaxosSystem.QuorumDecided

claims.name: liveness
claims.description: For the leader L, live majority Q and stabilisation time T of the assumptions (Fair), every member of Q decides at or after T.
claims.statement: ∀ (N : Nat) [PaxosSystem.Cluster N] (run : Nat → PaxosSystem.World N), RMVerify.Reactive.Execution (PaxosSystem.module N) run → ∀ L Q T, PaxosSystem.Fair run L Q T → RMVerify.Reactive.Eventually (fun w => ∀ c ∈ Q, (w.node c).decided ≠ .None) run T
claims.proof: by intro N _ run exec L Q T live; exact PaxosSystem.liveness run exec L Q T live

claims.name: fairness_needed
claims.description: Without the assumptions, a legal idle execution never decides, so the liveness premises are not idle.
claims.statement: ∀ (N : Nat) [PaxosSystem.Cluster N] (w : PaxosSystem.World N), PaxosSystem.Initial w → RMVerify.Reactive.Execution (PaxosSystem.module N) (fun _ => w) ∧ ¬ RMVerify.Reactive.Eventually (fun w => ∃ c, (w.node c).decided ≠ .None) (fun _ => w)
claims.proof: by intro N _ w h; exact PaxosSystem.idle_never_decides w h
